designs.name: asap7-sha256
designs.notes: Open-source SiliconCompiler/OpenROAD P&R; not the Innovus reference layout. LambdaPDK ASAP7 with its tech LEF from https://github.com/jeffhsu3/lambdapdk/tree/asap7-m1-eolkeepout (be6ee59: quarter-nanometre rule values made whole so OpenROAD keeps the M1 and M4-M7 EOL keep-outs), an on-grid M6/M7 power ring, M2-M5 PDN stacks on the M4 tracks and V6 cut pitch 0.077 um. Rebuild with open_flow/run_sha256.py --lambdapdk <checkout of that branch> (open-flow 3310ac0). Forked from Centre-for-Hardware-Security/asap7_reference_design. License not specified upstream.
